name: services/mailclient/put_attachment
description:
Upload an attachment.

This method works only with messages with status draft.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description:
The file to be attached.

Important: Currently there are no size limits for the attachments, but they might be in the future! However, you may assume that the maximum allowed size for a single attachment will never drop below 100 MB.

arguments.name: filename
arguments.description: The name of a file. No more than 100 characters. If omitted, the value will be taken from data field, but still character limit is implied.

arguments.name: content_type
arguments.description: Uploaded file content type. If you omit this argument, USOS API will try to guess it.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • attachment_id - attachment ID.
errors:
• object_invalid - message is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • attachment_limit_exceeded - maximum number of attachments for non-administrative consumers (10) exceeded.;

    • draft_required - message is not a draft.

  • object_not_found - message could not be found; param_name is equal to message_id.
